title: KONDE — Kontextualisierung von Reiseberichten (digital corpus of early modern travel accounts)
institution: Austrian Centre for Digital Humanities and Cultural Heritage (ACDH-CH, Austrian Academy of Sciences)
notes:
ACDH corpus project providing TEI-encoded, linguistically annotated full text of early modern travel literature together with facsimiles, hosted on the digitale-edition.at platform; distinct from the catalogued Grand Tour digital dataset. Exact text and word counts were not verified in this run.

Justification: TEI-encoded, editorially annotated full text of early modern travel accounts within 1450–1700, freely accessible on the Austrian digitale-edition.at platform and not in the catalogue; found via a re3data/DARIAH-oriented web search.
Found at: https://github.com/Pantagrueliste/renascor/pull/2
